caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair set against a plain, beige background. The chair has a curved crest rail at the top with decorative painting that includes a cluster of fruit in shades of green, yellow, red, and brown, as well as green leaf motifs. Below the crest rail is a horizontal slat with a matching floral design. The chair's stiles, stretchers, and legs are a medium brown wood tone, with additional painted green and yellow decorative stripes along some of the edges. The seat of the chair is also brown and features more painted ornamental detailing in similar colors to those on the backrest. The overall composition centers the chair on the page, with no other objects present.
title: Pa. German Chair
